quote: Poem summarization refers to the process of reducing a poem to its core ideas to provide a concise and informative overview of the content ... We have introduced a new task in the field of natural language understanding named 'Poem summarization' ...

In the abstractive summarization domain...we have introduced a novel poem summarization dataset named 'Poemsum'...We evaluated the performance of some of the standard summarization models like T5, BART, Pegasus, and mT5 on PoemSum...
